key.description: The setting: mostro-pubkey (MOSTRO_PUBKEY), relays (RELAYS), pow (POW) or transport (TRANSPORT)

value.description: The value, trimmed and checked as the commands check it: a public key (hex or npub), comma-separated ws:// or wss:// relay URLs, a number from 0 to 255, or nip44; put `--` before a value that starts with `-`
